item.title: Cincinnati’s vacant Terrace Plaza Hotel faces fresh redevelopment hurdles over tax dispute
item.description: Cincinnati's iconic Terrace Plaza Hotel has stood vacant since 2008, currently tied up in redevelopment plans. A contentious property tax valuation dispute between the owner and the city's school district has caused delays. This $160 million project seeks to honor the hotel's historical significance while also requiring a resolution of tax issues to proceed with construction, maintaining its vital role in the city’s architectural legacy. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: In run-up to mass protests and riots, pro-Russian accounts amplified French anger, NGO finds
item.description: Research carried out by the Alliance4Europe NGO suggests that pro-Russian networks manipulated information online in an effort to exacerbate anger in France ahead of last weekend's massive protests and subsequent unrest. After analysing more than half a million posts across various social media platforms, the group says it was able to track the campaign back to the start of September. FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney speaks with Omri Preiss, Managing Director at the Alliance4Europe. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Sharon GAFFNEY

item.title: Trump exploits France riots to push false immigration claims ahead of midterms
item.description: Donald Trump and his inner circle are using unrest in France to push unsubstantiated claims blaming the riots on immigration, even showing French protest footage at midterm rallies. But there is no evidence linking immigration to the unrest, and it's prompted French President Emmanuel Macron to accuse world leaders of making “stupid comments” at France’s expense. Trump’s focus comes as Republicans face mounting pressure ahead of the midterms and his approval rating hits a reported record low. Fuente: France 24 - English.
